## New in this release

### Fixed
- **Settings → Reset all** and **Subject colors → Reset all:** the "Undo" message at the bottom now disappears after a few seconds instead of staying on screen.

### Behind the scenes
- Version numbering: unreleased changes only raise the build number, so visible versions are no longer skipped.

### Known issues
- Parent accounts that log in through **ID Austria** don't work yet.
